meta.name: ad-creative-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "write ad copy", "generate RSA headlines", or "build ad creative at volume"; produces ad units — RSA headlines/descriptions, hooks, and an angle matrix — message-matched to the destination landing page. Not for scoring an ad account — use ad-account-auditor; not for the post-click page — use landing-optimizer; not for organic articles — use content-writer. 广告创意/广告文案/RSA标题

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据落地页生成匹配的广告文案和创意矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量生成与落地页匹配的广告文案和标题。
copy.tagline_en: Generate ad copy and creative matrix matched to your landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce ad copy and headlines that match your landing page at scale.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的产品、落地页链接和广告平台，批量生成 RSA 广告标题、描述、钩子和角度矩阵。每条广告文案都会与落地页内容匹配，并检查是否有虚假宣传或违规风险。
howto.when: 当你要求“写广告文案”、“生成 RSA 标题”或“批量制作广告创意”，并提供了产品或落地页链接时触发。

say.text: 为这款健身课程构建 3 个角度 x 3 个钩子的矩阵，平台是 Meta
say.note: Claude 会输出角度矩阵和对应的钩子。

say.text: 迭代这些表现差的标题：[粘贴标题]，保留好的，替换差的，保持与落地页匹配
say.note: Claude 会分析并替换标题，确保信息一致。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate RSA headlines, descriptions, hooks, and an angle matrix in bulk based on your product, landing page URL, and ad platform. Each ad copy is message-matched to the landing page and checked for unsubstantiated claims or policy risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "write ad copy", "generate RSA headlines", or "build ad creative at volume", and provide a product or landing page URL.

say_en.text: Generate 15 RSA headlines and 4 descriptions for my coffee machine, landing page example.com/coffee
say_en.note: Claude reads the page and produces matched ad copy.

say_en.text: Build a 3-angle x 3-hook matrix for this fitness course, platform Meta
say_en.note: Claude outputs the angle matrix and hooks.

say_en.text: Iterate on these losing headlines: [paste], keep winners, replace rest, hold message-match to URL
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and replaces headlines while maintaining match.
